raw.details:
Overview

HackHere proudly presents THE SUMMIT EXPEDITION, a 24-hour national-level hackathon set against the breathtaking landscapes of Ooty, Tamil Nadu.

Participants will work on real-world challenges involving Forest Intelligence, Wildlife Technology, Predictive AI, Intelligent Simulation, Computer Vision, and Advanced Machine Learning, transforming complex environmental problems into impactful technological solutions.

Event Details

  • Event Dates: 19–20 December 2026
  • Location: Ooty, The Nilgiris, Tamil Nadu
  • Venue: To Be Announced
  • Hackathon Duration: 24 Hours
  • Mode: Offline
  • Team Size: 1–4 Members
  • Registration Fee: ₹1,000 per Team
  • Problem Statements: 2 Classified Missions

The Summit Expedition

Two Hidden Missions. One Ultimate Summit - Where Technology Meets the Untamed.

Inspired by the breathtaking landscapes, dense forests, and rich biodiversity surrounding the Nilgiris, The Summit Expedition brings together the spirit of exploration and the power of emerging technologies.

This 24-hour national hackathon challenges innovators to push technological boundaries through Forest Intelligence, Wildlife Technology, Predictive AI, Intelligent Simulation, Computer Vision, and Advanced Machine Learning.

Participants will explore real-world environmental challenges, transforming complex problems into intelligent, innovative, and impactful technological solutions.

Two Missions Await

Mission 01 - The fireline

Predict the Unpredictable. Contain the Uncontrollable.

Step into the unpredictable world of forest ecosystems, where changing environmental conditions demand intelligent solutions. Explore Predictive AI, Advanced Simulation, Autonomous Systems, and Optimisation Technologies to tackle complex challenges involving forest safety, risk prediction, and environmental resilience.

Mission 02 - Echoes of the Wild

Every Sound. Every Shadow. A Discovery.

Venture into the unexplored world of wildlife intelligence, where nature holds patterns waiting to be discovered. Harness Multimodal AI, Computer Vision, Acoustic Intelligence, and Advanced Machine Learning to uncover hidden biodiversity insights and explore the mysteries of the natural world.

The Expedition Begins at Basecamp

Every team will be assigned one of two classified problem statements, officially revealed on the event day.

With 24 hours on the clock, participants must research, innovate, experiment, and transform their ideas into working technological solutions.

But reaching the summit won't be that simple.

Hour 12 - The Fog Descends

When the path changes, true innovators find another way.

Halfway through the expedition, an unexpected twist awaits. A surprise bonus challenge will push teams beyond their original mission, testing their adaptability, technical creativity, and problem-solving abilities.

Teams that successfully overcome this additional challenge can earn bonus points towards their final evaluation.

2 Secret Missions | 24 Hours | 1 Summit | 1 Prize Pool

The summit isn't given. It's earned.

Internship Opportunities

Outstanding participants and teams may receive internship opportunities through our industry partners:

  • Go.Hub
  • Scida Forest
  • Elro Tech
  • Delyon

Internship selections will depend on technical performance, evaluation outcomes, company requirements, and eligibility criteria.

Goodies & Swags

Exciting event goodies, merchandise, and swags for participants, subject to availability and distribution arrangements.

Certificates

Participation certificates for eligible participants who complete the required hackathon activities, along with special recognition for winning teams.

Industry Exposure & Mentorship

Interact with industry professionals, technical mentors, and evaluators while gaining hands-on experience solving real-world challenges.

Portfolio & Networking Opportunities

Build a meaningful technical project, demonstrate your skills, connect with fellow innovators, and expand your professional network.

Eligibility & Team Formation

  • Open to undergraduate and postgraduate students from colleges and universities.
  • Participants from different academic departments and institutions can form teams.
  • Each team must consist of 1 to 4 members.
  • Individual participation is permitted.
  • Every participant must register as part of only one team.
  • All registered members must participate in the event.

Registration Details

Registration Fee: ₹1,000 per Team

The registration fee applies to the entire team, irrespective of whether the team consists of 1, 2, 3, or 4 members.

Registration Process:

  • Register your team through Unstop.
  • Enter the required team and participant details.
  • Complete the registration payment according to the official instructions.
  • Await registration and payment confirmation from the organising team.
  • Follow the official communication channels for event instructions, reporting details, and updates.

Registration will be considered confirmed only after the required verification process.

Hackathon Rules & Regulations

  • Team Composition: Each team must consist of 1–4 members. Cross-college and interdisciplinary teams are permitted.
  • Original Development: The main project must be developed during the hackathon. Fully pre-built projects submitted as new work are prohibited.
  • Problem Statement Allocation: Each team will be assigned one of the two classified missions. The assigned problem statement must be followed.
  • Use of Existing Technologies: Open-source libraries, frameworks, public datasets, pretrained models, and AI development tools may be used, provided their usage is disclosed appropriately.
  • Bonus Challenge: The 12th-hour task is optional. Bonus points will be awarded according to the evaluation guidelines announced by the organisers.
  • Equipment: Participants must bring their own laptops, chargers, and other essential development equipment.
  • Code of Conduct: Participants must maintain professional behaviour and follow all venue and event regulations.
  • Refreshment will be Provided, Food will not be providedRegistration Fee will not be refunded

Learn • Build • Connect • Grow
